reproduce_first.note: The root cause was identified before editing, but no failure was reproduced before the fix.

assumptions_recorded.note: The ask specifies the bug to fix.

stack_discovery.note: The project files were read, but no package scripts or README check commands were discovered before choosing checks.

incremental_slices.note: The change was made in one edit and checks were run afterward.

self_review.note: No diff review or explicit correctness/readability review is recorded before reporting done.

simplification_pass.note: No behavior-preserving cleanup and second check run are recorded.

test_experiment.note: Tests were added and passed, but no test failure before the fix or intentional failure experiment is shown.

docs_where_behavior_changed.note: The change is an internal ID fix and no existing documentation is shown to have become stale.

scope_kept.note: The recorded changes address todo ID reuse and duplicate IDs without listing unrelated fixes.

verification_story.note: The summary names unit tests, typecheck, and lint results and says browser checks were not run, but does not report what was checked by hand.

hand_check.note: The done summary explicitly says the running app and browser end-to-end tests were not exercised.
